title: Can we add bulk export to the data pipeline?
body: We need to export thousands of records but the tool only exports one at a time. Please add a batch export feature.

title: Expose a bulk update API endpoint
body: Our workflow requires updating hundreds of items but the API only allows single updates. We need a batch endpoint.

title: 5 nested API calls just to get a deployment status
body: Why does retrieving deployment status require 5 separate API calls? This creates unnecessary complexity for developers.

title: Error messages are too cryptic for developers
body: The API returns error codes like ERR_4892 with no human-readable description. Developers cannot diagnose issues without grepping source code.

title: No webhook support for build completions
body: We need real-time notifications when builds complete. Currently polling every minute which is wasteful.

title: Cannot integrate with Slack for notifications
body: There is no Slack integration for our internal tooling platform. We have to check the dashboard manually every hour.

title: Would love a dark mode for the dashboard
body: The UI is bright white and eye-straining for late-night work. A dark mode option would be very helpful for the team.

title: Request for a mobile-friendly or responsive UI
body: Our team works from mobile devices frequently. The current UI does not scale to small screens at all.

title: Where is the OAuth2 setup documentation?
body: I cannot find any documentation about configuring OAuth2 for the internal platform. Please help.

title: No documentation on API rate limits
body: How many API calls can I make per minute? I cannot find rate limit information anywhere in the docs or FAQ.

title: Setup guide explains what but not how
body: The setup guide lists all the configuration options but does not explain how they interact or how to use them together in a real scenario.

title: Code examples in docs are outdated
body: The example code on the getting-started page uses a deprecated API that no longer works. It took me two hours to figure out why.

title: Setup guide says v2 but API reference shows v3
body: Two official documentation pages show different API versions. I do not know which one to follow for our deployment.

title: Two pages show different YAML config formats
body: The YAML configuration format differs between the getting-started guide and the advanced configuration reference page.

title: Authentication docs are split across 3 different pages
body: To fully understand authentication I had to read 3 separate documentation pages that should be one cohesive guide.

title: Deployment requires cross-referencing 4 separate documents
body: Setting up a production deployment requires reading 4 different docs. The information should be consolidated into one guide.

title: TLS certificate configuration is extremely complex
body: Configuring TLS for our internal cluster requires 15 steps spread across 4 different configuration files with no single guide.

title: 15 environment variables needed just to start the service
body: The application requires 15 environment variables to boot and half of them are undocumented. Getting a new engineer onboarded takes a full day.

title: Permission denied on every production deployment
body: I get a permission-denied error on every deployment to production. The same scripts work fine in development and staging.

title: Docker container exits immediately on startup with no logs
body: The Docker container starts and immediately exits. There are no error logs to diagnose what went wrong.

title: Service works locally but fails in CI with different errors
body: Everything passes in local development but fails in CI with an environment-specific error. We cannot reproduce it locally.

title: No troubleshooting guide for connection failures
body: When the service fails to connect to the database there is no documentation on how to diagnose or resolve the issue.

title: Didn't know the batch import feature existed
body: A colleague showed me the batch import feature yesterday. Why is it not mentioned anywhere in the onboarding or the main navigation?

title: Found SSO support only by accident in an FAQ
body: We spent months managing user accounts manually. We found SSO support buried in a rarely-visited FAQ article.

title: Assumed the legacy v1 API was fully deprecated
body: We stopped using v1 thinking it was deprecated but it is still fully supported and many teams rely on it.

title: Thought the advanced reporting features were paid-only
body: Our team avoided using the reporting module for months assuming it required a paid tier. It turned out to be included in our plan.

title: v4 release broke our scripts with no prior warning
body: The v4 release changed the configuration file format silently. We had no advance warning and our production scripts broke overnight.
expected_sub: Poor communication of changes or releases

title: No release notes for renamed config keys in v3
body: Configuration keys were renamed in v3 but there were no release notes or migration guide explaining the changes.
expected_sub: Poor communication of changes or releases

title: Worker service crashes with OOM error every few hours
body: The worker service crashes with OutOfMemoryError every 3 to 4 hours and must be restarted manually. This is a critical stability issue.

title: Service randomly restarts with no error message in logs
body: Our API service restarts randomly every few days with no error logged. It is nearly impossible to diagnose the root cause.

title: Simple SELECT query on 10k rows takes 30 seconds
body: A basic SELECT query on a 10000 row table takes 30 seconds to return. This completely blocks our downstream workflows.

title: Dashboard freezes when loading datasets with over 1000 rows
body: Loading datasets with more than 1000 rows causes the dashboard to freeze for up to a minute before rendering.

title: API returns HTTP 500 with an empty response body
body: When my request fails I get a 500 Internal Server Error with an empty body. There is no way to determine what went wrong.

title: Requests time out intermittently with no retry guidance
body: Our requests time out intermittently under load. There is no documentation on configuring retries or exponential backoff.

title: Another team can browse our private repository
body: We set the repository visibility to private but members of a separate team can still browse all of our files and history.

title: Admin role does not restrict access as documented
body: Users assigned the admin role can view resources they should be blocked from per the official documentation.

title: Cloud VPC cannot reach our internal service endpoint
body: Our AWS VPC cannot reach the internal service endpoint. This appears to be a network routing or firewall configuration issue.

title: Does the platform encrypt user data at rest?
body: For GDPR compliance we need written confirmation that all stored user data is encrypted at rest. Where is this documented?

title: How long does the platform retain user data by default?
body: We need to know the default data retention period for GDPR purposes. This is not documented anywhere we can find.

title: Need a full API call audit trail for our SOC2 audit
body: Our compliance team requires a complete audit trail of all API calls made through the platform for our upcoming SOC2 audit.

title: Migrating from v1 API to v2 without service downtime
body: We are on the v1 API and need to migrate to v2. Is there a migration guide that covers a zero-downtime cutover approach?

title: Moving our CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
body: We are migrating all CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions and looking for guidance on translating our existing pipeline configs.

title: v4.0 upgrade broke the lint step in our CI pipeline
body: After upgrading the core library to v4.0 the lint step in our CI pipeline fails with a new parsing error that was not present in v3.

title: Library upgrade to v2 broke all integration tests
body: After upgrading the authentication library to v2 all of our integration tests fail with a type mismatch that was introduced as a breaking change.

title: The initial setup process is overwhelming for new engineers
body: There are so many steps required to get the platform running that new engineers frequently give up. A simpler quick-start guide is needed.

title: Critical plugin is incompatible with the latest platform version
body: Our most-used plugin stopped working after the platform upgrade. There is no compatible version available and no timeline for one.

title: I have been using the deprecated v1 endpoint by mistake
body: I just realized I have been calling the deprecated v1 endpoint instead of the v2 replacement. What is the correct v2 endpoint path?

title: Same question as the OAuth thread from last week
body: This is the same issue that was answered in question 456 about OAuth token expiry. Please refer to that thread.

title: It doesn't work
body: It doesn't work please help me.
